limitations: Public profitability descriptions can refer to different financial measures.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Except possibly Midjourney, every LLM company is unprofitable, often wildly so.

statement.excerpt: Outside of one exception — Midjourney, which claimed it was profitable in 2022, which may not still be the case, I’ve reached out to ask— every single Large Language Model company is unprofitable, often wildly so.
statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

from_speaker: every single Large Language Model company is unprofitable
our_interpretation: The surrounding paragraph includes businesses building models and businesses selling products built on others' models. It does not naturally include the consolidated finances of diversified technology companies.
The plain reading is company-wide losses, rather than negative gross margins or cash consumption alone.
For the ongoing financial observation, use April–June 2025, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication. Zitron supplies no reporting period.
The universal assertion does not identify an accounting basis. The reference to Midjourney's own profitability claim does not establish a basis for every other company.
A single qualifying profitable company would defeat the universal assertion. 'Often wildly so' has no separate numerical threshold.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable company-wide financial results show losses throughout the defined population, excluding Midjourney, for the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one qualifying company other than Midjourney reports company-wide profit for the target period on an accounting basis comparable to the claim.
